name: ios

gates.name: Build
gates.command: set -o pipefail && xcodebuild build -scheme "$SCHEME" -destination "generic/platform=iOS Simulator" | xcbeautify

gates.name: Test
gates.command: set -o pipefail && xcodebuild test -scheme "$SCHEME" -destination "platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 16" | xcbeautify

acceptance: boot a simulator (xcrun simctl boot), install & launch the app, assert via a UI test or an xcrun simctl screenshot
notes: The ios-native and swift-testing skills come from the optional ios plugin and auto-load on *.swift.
